**Bhagyashri Borse** (born 6 May 1999) is an Indian actress who appears primarily in [Telugu](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Telugu_Language "Telugu Language") and [Tamil](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tamil_Language "Tamil Language") films. After doing cameo appearances in [Hindi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hindi_cinema "Hindi cinema") films _[Yaariyan 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yaariyan\_2 "Yaariyan 2")_ (2023) and _[Chandu Champion](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chandu\_Champion "Chandu Champion")_ (2024), she made her lead debut in South with the Telugu film _[Mr. Bachchan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mr.\_Bachchan "Mr. Bachchan")_ (2024) for which she has won the [SIIMA Award for Best Female Debut – Telugu](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SIIMA_Award_for_Best_Female_Debut_%E2%80%93_Telugu "SIIMA Award for Best Female Debut – Telugu").[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagyashri_Borse#cite_note-auto2-1)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagyashri_Borse#cite_note-auto1-2)

## Early life and education

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Bhagyashri_Borse&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Early life and education")]

Borse was born in [Aurangabad](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aurangabad "Aurangabad") (now known as [Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chhatrapati_Sambhajinagar "Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar")), [Maharashtra, India](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maharashtra,_India "Maharashtra, India").[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagyashri_Borse#cite_note-auto2-1) She lived in [Lagos, Nigeria](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lagos "Lagos"), for seven years during her schooling before moving back to India. She later studied business management (BMS) in [Mumbai](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mumbai "Mumbai") while pursuing modelling.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagyashri_Borse#cite_note-econtimes-3)

## Career

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Bhagyashri_Borse&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Career")]

Bhagyashri made a cameo appearance in [Hindi cinema](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hindi_cinema "Hindi cinema") with _[Yaariyan 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yaariyan\_2 "Yaariyan 2")_ (2023) and _[Chandu Champion](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chandu\_Champion "Chandu Champion")_ (2024). She entered [Telugu cinema](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Telugu_cinema "Telugu cinema") with _[Mr. Bachchan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mr.\_Bachchan "Mr. Bachchan")_ (2024), directed by [Harish Shankar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harish_Shankar "Harish Shankar") and starring [Ravi Teja](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ravi_Teja "Ravi Teja").[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagyashri_Borse#cite_note-auto2-1) Bhagyashri’s performance in _Mr. Bachchan_ received attention from critics. [Cinema Express](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cinema_Express "Cinema Express") observed that director Harish Shankar “relies on commercial treatment but gives enough room for his female lead Bhagyashri Borse to shine.”[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagyashri_Borse#cite_note-4)[Deccan Chronicle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deccan_Chronicle "Deccan Chronicle") later featured her among rising Telugu cinema talents, noting that her “transition from modelling to mainstream Telugu films has drawn strong audience recall.”[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagyashri_Borse#cite_note-5)

Her breakthrough came with [_Kingdom_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kingdom_(2025_film) "Kingdom (2025 film)") (2025), an action thriller directed by [Gowtam Tinnanuri](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gowtam_Tinnanuri "Gowtam Tinnanuri") and starring [Vijay Deverakonda](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vijay_Deverakonda "Vijay Deverakonda"), where she played a significant role.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagyashri_Borse#cite_note-auto1-2)[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagyashri_Borse#cite_note-6) She was later seen as a lead alongside [Ram Pothineni](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ram_Pothineni "Ram Pothineni") in _[Andhra King Taluka](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andhra\_King\_Taluka "Andhra King Taluka")_, and also opposite [Dulquer Salmaan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dulquer_Salmaan "Dulquer Salmaan") in her Tamil debut film _[Kaantha](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kaantha "Kaantha")_, for which she gained a lot of praise as the audience called her the new age Mahanati.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagyashri_Borse#cite_note-7)

**Bhagyashri Borse** (born 6 May 1999) is an Indian actress who appears primarily in [Telugu](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Telugu_Language "Telugu Language") and [Tamil](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tamil_Language "Tamil Language") films. After doing cameo appearances in [Hindi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hindi_cinema "Hindi cinema") films _[Yaariyan 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yaariyan\_2 "Yaariyan 2")_ (2023) and _[Chandu Champion](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chandu\_Champion "Chandu Champion")_ (2024), she made her lead debut in South with the Telugu film _[Mr. Bachchan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mr.\_Bachchan "Mr. Bachchan")_ (2024) for which she has won the [SIIMA Award for Best Female Debut – Telugu](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SIIMA_Award_for_Best_Female_Debut_%E2%80%93_Telugu "SIIMA Award for Best Female Debut – Telugu").[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagyashri_Borse#cite_note-auto2-1)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagyashri_Borse#cite_note-auto1-2)

## Early life and education

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Bhagyashri_Borse&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Early life and education")]

Borse was born in [Aurangabad](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aurangabad "Aurangabad") (now known as [Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chhatrapati_Sambhajinagar "Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar")), [Maharashtra, India](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maharashtra,_India "Maharashtra, India").[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagyashri_Borse#cite_note-auto2-1) She lived in [Lagos, Nigeria](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lagos "Lagos"), for seven years during her schooling before moving back to India. She later studied business management (BMS) in [Mumbai](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mumbai "Mumbai") while pursuing modelling.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagyashri_Borse#cite_note-econtimes-3)

## Career

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Bhagyashri_Borse&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Career")]

Bhagyashri made a cameo appearance in [Hindi cinema](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hindi_cinema "Hindi cinema") with _[Yaariyan 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yaariyan\_2 "Yaariyan 2")_ (2023) and _[Chandu Champion](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chandu\_Champion "Chandu Champion")_ (2024). She entered [Telugu cinema](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Telugu_cinema "Telugu cinema") with _[Mr. Bachchan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mr.\_Bachchan "Mr. Bachchan")_ (2024), directed by [Harish Shankar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harish_Shankar "Harish Shankar") and starring [Ravi Teja](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ravi_Teja "Ravi Teja").[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagyashri_Borse#cite_note-auto2-1) Bhagyashri’s performance in _Mr. Bachchan_ received attention from critics. [Cinema Express](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cinema_Express "Cinema Express") observed that director Harish Shankar “relies on commercial treatment but gives enough room for his female lead Bhagyashri Borse to shine.”[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagyashri_Borse#cite_note-4)[Deccan Chronicle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deccan_Chronicle "Deccan Chronicle") later featured her among rising Telugu cinema talents, noting that her “transition from modelling to mainstream Telugu films has drawn strong audience recall.”[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagyashri_Borse#cite_note-5)

Her breakthrough came with [_Kingdom_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kingdom_(2025_film) "Kingdom (2025 film)") (2025), an action thriller directed by [Gowtam Tinnanuri](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gowtam_Tinnanuri "Gowtam Tinnanuri") and starring [Vijay Deverakonda](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vijay_Deverakonda "Vijay Deverakonda"), where she played a significant role.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagyashri_Borse#cite_note-auto1-2)[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagyashri_Borse#cite_note-6) She was later seen as a lead alongside [Ram Pothineni](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ram_Pothineni "Ram Pothineni") in _[Andhra King Taluka](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andhra\_King\_Taluka "Andhra King Taluka")_, and also opposite [Dulquer Salmaan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dulquer_Salmaan "Dulquer Salmaan") in her Tamil debut film _[Kaantha](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kaantha "Kaantha")_, for which she gained a lot of praise as the audience called her the new age Mahanati.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagyashri_Borse#cite_note-7)
